Existing story: S-1 · Update member mailing address As a member service agent, I want to update a member's mailing address from the member profile page, so that statements go to the right place.
Existing AC: - Agent opens the member profile and edits the address fields - New address is saved on the member record - A success message is shown
Corrected story: Title: Update member mailing address (permission-controlled) Add to description: only users with the "Profile Update" permission may edit; all other users see the address fields read-only (NFR-2).
Complete acceptance criteria: Scenario: agent with Profile Update permission edits and saves address → new address stored, success message shown Scenario: user WITHOUT Profile Update permission opens profile → address fields are read-only, no edit action available Scenario: saved change appears on the member record immediately
Completeness: 60% — missing: CP-17 (permission restriction), CP-18 (read-only for others)

Existing story: S-2 · Validate address with USPS before save As a member service agent, I want the entered address to be checked against USPS, so that we store deliverable addresses.
Existing AC: - On save, the address is sent to the USPS validation service - If USPS returns a standardized address, the agent can accept it - The accepted address is stored on the member record
Corrected story: Title: no change. Add to description: agent may correct the input instead of accepting the suggestion (FR-2); P.O. Box rejected as residential, allowed as mailing (BR-1); USPS unavailable → supervisor override saves with a re-validation flag (NFR-3).
Complete acceptance criteria: Scenario: USPS returns standardized address → agent accepts → stored Scenario: agent rejects suggestion and corrects the input → corrected address re-validated and stored Scenario: P.O. Box entered as residential address → save blocked with message Scenario: P.O. Box entered as mailing address → allowed Scenario: USPS service down → supervisor override permits save; record flagged for re-validation
Completeness: 30% — missing: CP-6 (correct input), CP-7 (override), CP-8 (re-validation flag), CP-11/12 (P.O. Box rules)

Corrected story: NEW-1: Send address-change email confirmation As a member, I receive an email confirmation after my address is changed, so that I can detect unauthorized changes.
Complete acceptance criteria: Scenario: address change saved → confirmation email sent to the member's email on file within 15 minutes Scenario: email includes old→new summary and a "not you? contact us" path

Corrected story: NEW-2: Block address change under fraud hold As a fraud analyst, I want address changes blocked on accounts with an active fraud hold, so that account-takeover is prevented.
Complete acceptance criteria: Scenario: account has active fraud hold → save blocked Scenario: agent sees message directing them to the fraud team

Corrected story: NEW-3: Audit trail for address changes As a compliance officer, I need every address change audited, so that we meet retention obligations.
Complete acceptance criteria: Scenario: change saved → audit record stores old address, new address, user, date/time, channel Scenario: audit records retained 7 years and retrievable
